etherscan.note: Requires an API key. Failover only, behind the single public node, used by the CLI, CI and the server-side proxy. This key's plan allows 3 calls per second. Not available on Robinhood Chain (4663), Tempo (4217) or Arc (5042).

1.name: Ethereum
1.verified: 2026-09-09: publicnode chosen as the single provider after timing: 46 reads in 0.41 s median; answers browser requests, batches and Multicall3. 1RPC (0.55 s, batching off), Merkle (rate limits) and Cloudflare (internal errors) were dropped.

8453.name: Base
8453.verified: 2026-09-09: publicnode as the single provider; the official Base node was the alternative and is no longer used.

4663.name: Robinhood Chain
4663.verified: 2026-09-09: publicnode as the single provider; the official Robinhood node lagged it by a few blocks and is no longer used. Etherscan does not cover this chain.

morphoChains.note: Chains indexed by the Morpho API on 2026-09-04. Vaults on chains without an 'rpc' entry above are identified via the API and the chain check, but on-chain reads are unavailable and every card shows 'single source'.

pinLagNote: pinLag = how many blocks behind the latest block every read is pinned, so that the whole run reads one consistent state. Ethereum 2, Base 5, Robinhood 5.
rpcEntryNote: One public node per chain, publicnode everywhere it exists. An rpc entry is a URL, or { url, batch: false } for nodes that reject JSON-RPC batch requests. Etherscan is appended by the code as a failover only, never as a comparison.
